name: F1 Neuenhof / Heitersberg tunnel: block sections instead of one 3.3 km link
why: OSM way 83270426 (bore A, tracks=1, tunnel=yes, railway:etcs=1) and way 4257794 (bore B) are one track per direction; the router models the 3 306 m bore as ONE railSim resource, so the IC1/IC5 pair that the timetable books 25-66 s apart cannot follow each other, although block signalling (ETCS) allows it.  Splitting the long link into 6 block sections of 551 m (14 s at 140 km/h) reproduces that.
